task.title: Favorite your most used services
task.shortdesc: To easily access your most used services, add them to your Favorited Services page by clicking the star icon next to the name of a service. You can also add the widget for My favorite services to your home page for quick access.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud ConsoleHybrid Cloud Console, open the All Services page.
To search for a service, enter a service name, product, or keyword in the Find a service search bar.
After you find the service that you are looking for, complete any of the following tasks:

ul.li: To add a service to the Favorites page, hover over the service name and click the star icon that appears. Any service that you add as a favorite displays a yellow star next to the service name.
To view your list of favorite services, click Favorites. The Favorited Services page opens with a list of the services that you selected.
To remove a service from your Favorites page, click the star icon next to the service. The star disappears and the service is no longer listed on the Favorites page.
